name: Progress captions
description: The phrase on screen with a thin bar under it that fills with the voice, a glowing head at its end, the words lighting up as they are said. Give a transcript with --words.

text.label: Text
text.description: what is said; leave empty to caption the transcript as it is. Wrap a word in *stars* for the accent
text.default: A thin bar that fills as the *voice* goes on.

accents.label: Accent words
accents.description: words to put in the accent wherever they are said, comma separated
